hook: Heating dense matter shrinks the density range that perturbative QCD allows for neutron stars.

readout.label: DD2 density excluded by pQCD at entropy 5

summary: Earlier work showed perturbative QCD limits the equation of state of cold dense matter. The authors extend the bound to finite temperature along fixed entropy per baryon, finding the allowed region shrinks as temperature rises; for the DD2 model the limit falls from 1.0 to 0.74 per cubic femtometer. By entropy per baryon 4, seven of eleven mean-field models are excluded at six times saturation density. The bound is theoretical and depends on the extrapolation assumptions.
title: Perturbative QCD Constraints on Hot Neutron-Star Matter
